subject: KMS operations runbook & rotation logs — SIG evidence request
body:
From: Arielle Stone <arielles@bluepeak.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KMS artifacts for SIG — runbook + rotation logs request

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of the SIG assessment we need a concise bundle that demonstrates operational controls for key management: a runbook that covers key lifecycle (creation, rotation, retirement), an access matrix for people/services that can request key operations, and a machine-readable export of rotation events for Q3 2028.

Can you provide:
- A short operational runbook/cheat-sheet (PDF) we can include in the SIG submission
- Rotation event export (CSV) covering 2028-07-01 to 2028-09-30
- Current KMS/HSM access matrix (spreadsheet)

Target: we are submitting to the reviewer on Monday 22 Oct. If you can get a first draft by EOD Friday that would be great. If anything is sensitive, flag it and we can take it via the secure upload link.

Thanks,
Arielle Stone
Security Program Manager
BluePeak Technologies

---
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Arielle Stone <arielles@bluepeak.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Oct 2028 13:08:12 -0400
Subject: Re: KMS artifacts for SIG — runbook + rotation logs request

Arielle —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marcus (Platform Ops) and Neha (Security) so we can assemble a minimal bundle that meets SIG expectations. We can provide a redacted CSV export and an operational runbook (1–2 pages).

Plan:
- Marcus will pull rotation events and provide a CSV (we'll redact token ids and any tenant PII).
- Neha will export the current access matrix and confirm who has HSM console privileges.
- I will produce a one-page runbook and include a short change log describing our rotation cadence and emergency key rotation procedure.

If BluePeak needs raw audit logs (syslog-level) we prefer to deliver those via your secure upload link — please paste it if needed. Otherwise we'll attach the three artifacts to an email thread.

I will aim to send the bundle by Friday 18:00 PT.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 09:34:45 -0700
Subject: Re: KMS artifacts for SIG — runbook + rotation logs request

Laura,

Attached is the rotation export for Q3 2028. Notes: we exported rotation events from the KMS audit table (rotation_type, key_id_hash, rotated_by_service, timestamp, pre_rotation_version -> post_rotation_version). We replaced key_id with a SHA256 hash prefix (first 12 chars) and removed tenant identifiers; we kept service names.

Attachment: rotation-log-2028Q3.csv (application/csv)

Also attached an interim access matrix (sensitive columns flagged) — recommend redaction on shared copies: kms-access-matrix_20281018.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Ben — can you pull the HSM attestation note (we have an annual attestation stored in SecureDocs) and paste the reference link? I don't want to include the full doc until Arielle confirms secure upload.

Marcus
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 11:02:09 -0400
Subject: Re: KMS artifacts for SIG — runbook + rotation logs request

Marcus — linked the attestation and added a short note. SecureDocs reference: https://securedocs.redwood.ai/docs/attestations/hsm-202807-attestation (access controlled).

Also attaching the runbook draft I put together with Laura (keeps to a single page, step-by-step for rotation and emergency revoke). See kms-ops-runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Ben Carter
Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Arielle Stone <arielles@bluepeak.com>, Security Team <security@bluepeak.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Oct 2028 16:44:01 -0400
Subject: KMS runbook + rotation export (Q3) — BluePeak SIG bundle (first draft)

Arielle / BluePeak security team —

Attached is the first draft bundle for SIG intake. Contents: 
- kms-ops-runbook_v1.pdf — one-page operational runbook, includes emergency rotation checklist
- rotation-log-2028Q3.csv — rotation events export, key ids redacted as hashes
- kms-access-matrix_20281018.xlsx — current human/service access matrix (sensitive columns marked)

Notes / guidance:
- We redacted tenant identifiers and replaced KMS key IDs with a truncated SHA256 prefix to preserve the ability to trace rotations while protecting tenant-specific material.
- The runbook includes our scheduled rotation cadence (90 days for customer-wrapped keys, 365 days for platform-hosted service keys) and the operator checklist for emergency rotate/fallback.
- If the SIG reviewer requires the HSM attestation PDF, we can provide via your secure upload link or an NDA channel; the attestation is linked here (access-controlled): https://securedocs.redwood.ai/docs/attestations/hsm-202807-attestation

If you want any additional columns in the rotation CSV (e.g., pre/post version digests), say the word and Marcus will re-export.

Cheers,
Laura

Attachments: kms-ops-runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf); rotation-log-2028Q3.csv (application/csv); kms-access-matrix_20281018.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

---
On Oct 20, 2028, at 18:03, Arielle Stone <arielles@bluepeak.com> wrote:

> Laura — thanks so much, this is exactly what we needed for the SIG intake.
>
> We'll upload the bundle into the secure portal and confirm receipt. Two quick asks:
> 1) Can you add a single line that explicitly states whether private keys ever leave the HSM in plaintext? (our reviewer often flags this)
> 2) For the access matrix, can you provide the last-reviewed date in the sheet metadata / a cell so we can show freshness?
>
> If you can include those two tiny edits by EOD Monday we'll be in great shape.
>
> —Arielle
>

[End of thread]
